Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.33.0 reworks the awakened Stormhammer. It now reuses the base hammer mesh and texture, because the player preferred that silhouette: the awakened identity comes from a live corona instead (orbiting glow ring plus crackling arcs between the ring points, roughly twice the rate and white-blue while the Thunder God window is open). Renamed: the base item is now 雷神之锤·伪 and the awakened form is 雷神之锤·妙尔尼尔. Myriad Tribulation lands for real immediately: the authoritative strike moved from 4.85 s to 0.28 s, the density phases open on the climax, and a new heavy layer drops 5 to 11 full sized branched bolts in the near field across the 12 s window (deterministic per cast id, gated on the main strike). Thunderous Judgment cooldown is down from 12 s to 8 s. The skill HUD is now icon and cooldown only: the skill names and the cyan outline frame are gone. Android rendering, frame cost and multiplayer remain pending device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
